why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Both removed handlers were only partly preserved, so both are restored in this overlay. renderClouds HEAD: CloudRendererMixin (CloudRenderer.render) misses dimensions whose DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds draws the clouds, which 1.21.1's HEAD cancel also skipped; eca$skipOccludingClouds now cancels lambda$addCloudsPass$6 at its renderClouds call (the clouds pass runs after the main pass, so the flag is final). renderSky TAIL: 1.21.1 drew the global skybox at renderSky TAIL, before NeoForge's AFTER_SKY dispatch, and returned before TAIL when a custom renderSky drew; 1.21.3 adds no sky pass when isFoggyAt (the Nether), for SkyType NONE, under lava/powder snow or with a sky-blocking effect, and fires AFTER_SKY even after a custom renderSky. Since ae83f7b the skybox (net.eca.mv.GlobalSkyboxHook.render, identity PoseStack because the pass runs after renderLevel pushed the view matrix onto the model-view stack, FOG_SKY fog) is drawn in one of two places: (1) on a frame with a sky pass (eca$recordSkyPass sets eca$skyPassAdded at addSkyPass's FrameGraphBuilder.addPass INVOKE; reset at renderLevel HEAD), inside the sky pass lambda lambda$addSkyPass$12 just before ClientHooks.dispatchRenderStage (eca$drawGlobalSkyboxBeforeAfterSky, with the lambda's FOG_SKY FogParameters), so other mods' AFTER_SKY content lies over it as in 1.21.1, skipped when that lambda's custom renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky); (2) only on a frame with no sky pass, from a separate eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main added just before addMainPass (eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass), skipped when the dimension's DimensionSpecialEffects class overrides renderSky at all (the declaring class of its renderSky is neither DimensionSpecialEffects nor NeoForge's IDimensionSpecialEffectsExtension default; cached per class), since 1.21.1 asked that override first and returned before TAIL when it drew. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass sets GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned on every frame, so its AFTER_SKY handler stands down. renderEntity HEAD/RETURN and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay.
